name: Show file name extensions
description: Shows file name extensions for known file types in File Explorer (View > Show > File name extensions; Settings > System > Advanced > File Explorer > Show file extensions) by setting HideFileExt = 0 (REG_DWORD) in HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced.
rationale: Visible extensions make it harder to disguise a program as a document (for example 'invoice.pdf.exe') and remove ambiguity when working with files.
effects: File Explorer shows extensions such as .exe, .pdf and .txt for all files.
sideEffects: File names appear longer, and renaming a file shows (and can change) its extension; File Explorer warns before an extension is changed.
notes: Microsoft's Microsoft.Windows.Developer DSC module (WindowsExplorer resource) uses HideFileExt = 0 for 'Show' and 1 for 'Hide', and restarts File Explorer to apply the change. WinLean does not restart File Explorer; open windows update after a refresh, a File Explorer restart or signing out.
Per-user preference; no Administrator rights are needed.
